content:
Emma: quick sync — we need to lock down the rerank score encoding + routing sensitivity before the quota/dashboard rollout tomorrow. console buckets are showing weird spikes from yesterday's canary. anyone seen this?
Raj: saw it. runtime emits score as float32 but the collector packs it to int16 to save bytes. losing precision makes bucket thresholds noisy.
Miguel: we did that packing on purpose for throughput. that said the consumer (console + sla-alerts) assumes continuous range. mismatch is the root cause.
Sara: product POV: console needs deterministic buckets for SLA alerts and to surface regressions. customers will notice flapping alerts. Can we add a normalization step in the console as a short-term fix?
Kevin: this also affects quota math. our current quota enforcement computes "score_units" = ceil(score * weight). If score quantization jumps, throttle decisions will oscillate.
Emma: high level options: (A) keep packed int but publish decoder + stable bucket mapping in telemetry (B) stop packing and emit float32 end-to-end (C) emit histogram summaries from collector. pros/cons?
Raj: (A) lowest infra work but brittle across versions. (B) simplest semantics, higher bandwidth. (C) elegant for dashboarding but loses per-candidate score for debugging.
Miguel: bandwidth hit for (B) is ~12% on rerank path at p95. We can mitigate with gzip and selective trace sampling.
Sara: also need a rollout UX: can we do per-tenant opt-in to new encoding + a console toggle to view legacy vs normalized buckets?
Emma: I prefer per-model/per-tenant toggles. Routing sensitivity should be model-scoped too — different models have different score distributions.
Raj: model-scoped sensitivity means more routing metadata in requests (model_id + distribution signature). that adds complexity to router and cache keys.
Kevin: complexity OK if it stabilizes SLA behavior. Ops would like an escape hatch: global fallback bucket mapping that applies when model signature missing.
Miguel: implementation sketch: change collector to emit both fields for a transition window: `score_float` and `score_q16`. collector sets `score_q16 = int16(round(score_float * 32767))`. telemetry pipeline emits both and console shows a toggle. after 2 weeks, flip default to float.
Emma: draft compatibility proto we can use for canary:
```
message RerankScoreEvent {
  string model_id = 1;
  float score_float = 2; // new canonical field
  int32 score_q16 = 3;  // legacy packed field (optional)
  map<string,string> meta = 4;
}
```
Raj: LGTM. router only needs `model_id` and `score_float` once collectors start populating it. until then, fallback to decode `score_q16`.
Sara: UX ask: add a flag in the console "Use legacy score encoding" with tooltip explaining jitter and a timestamp for when model started emitting float. Also show per-model distribution preview in the rollout flow.
Kevin: before flipping, we should run a canary across 5% tenants and compare throttle delta. I'll add SLO checks: no >2% change in 95th throttle rate.
Emma: ops note: deploy-bot started the collector canary earlier — @deploy-bot any status?
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for `rerank-collector/v2` on cluster `rerank-canary-3` (pods: 3). Monitoring: collector.mem < 70%, p50 latency +3ms.
Miguel: good. I'll push a collector change that emits `score_float` + `score_q16` behind a feature flag.
Raj: I'll update router fallback logic to prefer `score_float` when present; decode `score_q16` otherwise.
Sara: product will wire console toggle + distribution preview. Will draft copy for tooltip.
Emma: action items: Miguel -> collector canary with dual fields; Raj -> router fallback + tests; Kevin -> add SLO checks and canary gating; Sara -> console toggle + preview copy; Emma -> coordinate rollout plan + announce to platform slack.
Kevin: timeline request: canary + telemetry comparison in 48h?
Miguel: doable. pushing PR now.
Emma: thanks all. let's regroup after canary metrics. :thumbsup:
